objective: Find a read-only Bitget intraday long research candidate that maximizes conservative post-cost margin return under a fixed 5x leverage cap.

data_policy.train_validation: Chronological first 80 percent of each frozen candidate's completed-candle replay trades.
data_policy.held_out: Later 20 percent of exactly one validation-selected candidate; never read for candidate selection.
leakage_checks: Only completed 15m, 5m, and where relevant 1m candles are passed to a decision.
All candidates share the same 5x fee/slippage model and exit geometry.
Prior technical-score and Bollinger filters are entry filters only; they never alter the shared return calculation.
Historical fee use remains research-only and cannot authorize a live strategy.

candidates.name: breakout-volume-1.0
candidates.risk: baseline reference; no live promotion from historical data

candidates.name: breakout-technical-score-v1-volume-1.0
candidates.risk: research-only reuse of the existing causal score; never a live instruction

candidates.name: breakout-bollinger-squeeze-v1-volume-1.0
candidates.risk: source-backed hypothesis only; must earn selection on this evaluator

acceptance.validation: At least 80 settled signals, positive conservative post-cost return, and worst modeled all-in 5x stop loss no greater than 8 percent.
acceptance.held_out: At least 20 later settled signals and the same gates.

human_gates: No private Bitget account, position, leverage-setting, or order endpoint is permitted.
Any demo or real order requires a user-created credential and explicit user authorization.
Forward evidence is required before any live-promotion decision.
